description: AgentCraft QA camera set (docs/visual-bar.md, 'QA camera set'). Run with node tools/run-screenshot-qa.mjs (showcase busy state). Cameras come from the mod's dev.anchors (cam_* names, contract in docs/QA.md); 'camera' is only a fallback for shots whose subject does not depend on the HQ layout. A shot with neither is skipped with a reason.
